chapter_title: Concerning the Light Mind and the Apostles and the Saints
chapter_note: Long, complex chapter with a dominant substrate layer centered on body-cosmos correspondence (macro-micro mapping). Core substrate teaching includes: (1) the universe constructed as a human body (¶11-12) — classic correspondential mapping of organs to cosmic structures; (2) five sons of the Living Spirit as five intellectual faculties stationed in five cosmic watch-districts (¶13-17); (3) rebellion narratives in each watch-district with cosmic responses (¶19-28); (4) the soul-body binding formula — mind/bone, thought/sinew, insight/vein, counsel/flesh, consideration/skin (¶35) — and its systematic reversal by the Light Mind (¶38); (5) the new man's five virtues mapped to five faculties (¶40); (6) Sin's progressive rebellion through the five faculties in reverse order (¶43-49, extracted from institutional wrapping). Clear editorial fatigue: ¶44-50 embed substrate faculty-progression in institutional church-discipline narrative; ¶57-67 are entirely institutional apostolate material with exhortative closure. The substrate fatigue shift (-2.93) and institutional shift (+1.19) confirm the second half is editorially overlaid. The body-cosmos mapping and soul-body binding formula are among the most pristine substrate passages in the entire Kephalaia.
